pd_statement: The works of Wallace D. Wattles (1860–1911) collected here were first published between 1905 and 1910 and are in the public domain. This edition follows the first editions or early printings where available: The Science of Getting Rich, The Science of Being Well and The Science of Being Great (Elizabeth Towne, Holyoke, 1910); Hell-Fire Harrison (L. C. Page & Company, Boston, 1910); What Is Truth? (The Nautilus, 1909); The New Science of Living and Healing (1924 reissue, without the later commentary); A New Christ, Jesus: The Man and His Work, Making the Man Who Can and How to Get What You Want from later printings. Wattles’ wording and spelling are kept; obvious printing errors are corrected. The chapter titles of How to Get What You Want are editorial.

paras: In 1910 Wallace D. Wattles published a slim book that has never gone out of print: The Science of Getting Rich, the work that later inspired the bestseller The Secret. In the same year he wrote The Science of Being Well and The Science of Being Great – and much more.

This beautifully designed annotated edition gathers ten of his works in one volume, from the three ‘Science’ books to his writings on success, health and the teachings of Jesus, and his only novel, Hell-Fire Harrison – each complete, with an introduction, a plain-language note and a small practice for every chapter, and a guided 30-day practice.
